name: biceps-curl-dumbbell-alternating
title: Biceps Curl: Dumbbell (Alternating)
primer: This exercise is a single arm version of a biceps curl.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your knees slightly bent and your abs drawn in.
Grasp a dumbbell in each hand so your palms are facing up.
Extend your arms so they are at the sides of your body.
Keeping your elbows at your sides, lift your left arm to your chest so that your forearm touches your biceps.
Lower your arm and repeat with your right arm.
tips: Do not swing your body as you perform this exercise.
